mapper.select: /* RiskImpr01Mapper.selectImprovementItems */ SELECT A.IMPROVEMENT_SEQ AS improvementSeq , A.IMPROVE_DATE AS improveDate , A.IMPROVE_DESC AS improveDesc , A.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_NAME', A.FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS fileName , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_PATH', A.FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS filePath , A.LIKELIHOOD_SCORE AS likelihoodScore , A.SEVERITY_SCORE AS severityScore , A.RISK_LV AS riskLv FROM TB_RISK_IMPROVEMENT_ITEM A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.PROCESS_CD = #{processCd} AND A.ASSESSMENT_CD = #{assessmentCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.IMPROVEMENT_SEQ DESC
